title: Abraj Al Bait
visualBrief: The seven-tower complex includes a mapped stepped podium, warm stone hotel facades, six lower towers with tensioned roof tents and glass lanterns, plus the cardinal clock tower with four differently proportioned dials, V supports, a faceted glass jewel, gold spire and closed solid crescent.
